subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this staged native durable-runtime subsystem and target it for the 2026.7.1 release line after the delivery-safety blockers are fixed?
rationale: This is a new persistent core runtime and multi-PR recovery contract; technical repair cannot determine its permanent ownership or release commitment.

options.title: Sponsor with strict landing gates
options.body: Approve the direction, require the replay defects and real proof to be resolved, then review and land the stack in order.

options.title: Defer to a later release
options.body: Keep the work open but move it off the current release line until ownership and rollout are established.

options.title: Decline core adoption
options.body: Close the dependent stack if durable coordination should not become an OpenClaw core subsystem.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with strict landing gates
recommendation.body: Approve the direction, require the replay defects and real proof to be resolved, then review and land the stack in order.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-cutting core runtime and release-direction choice is best routed to the strongest adjacent owner in the affected history.
